title: Monolith to Microservices
lead: Covers (guest session, part 2): Conway's Law, N-tier layering and the controller / service / repository rule, how clients and servers talk (HTTP, REST, status codes), the monolith, the modular monolith, microservices and their costs, the honest checklist, worked examples, the Prime Video case, five microservice patterns, orchestration vs choreography. No prior lecture attendance needed.
